title: Jupiter (FCP 2026)
synopsis: France’s new President Paul Archambault faces his first test when a nuclear crisis erupts after an attack on Russia’s leader. Trapped in a bunker beneath the Élysée Palace, he must make life-or-death choices as global tensions spiral.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 法國新任總統Paul Archambault迎來上任後首個考驗：俄羅斯領袖遇襲後驟然引發核戰危機。受困於愛麗舍宮地堡裡的他，必須在全球緊張局勢急劇升溫之際，作出生死抉擇。

cast: Denis Ménochet, Ella Rumpf, Céline Sallette, Dominique Blanc
